body.label: Trigger
body.html: You or an ally within 3 units is targeted by a ranged Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: The target gains +1 Defense against the triggering Action. If the Action fails, move the target 1 unit.

surges.html: Choose one additional eligible creature within 1 unit to receive a non-damage benefit of this Reaction.
Increase the Defense bonus from this Reaction by 1.
